name: Contraction Can Increase a Transported Quadratic Score
definition: Label $Q_4$ by binary integers $0,\ldots,15$, with coordinate $0$ least significant. Orient its edges toward later vertices in the order $14,6,10,12,8,4,9,0,1,11,3,7,2,15,5,13$. Contract coordinate $0$ and order each image vertex by the position of its last preimage; the induced order is $8,0,10,6,2,14,4,12$ on $Q_3$.
properties: The displayed $Q_4$ order has orientation score one: only the square $\{2,3,6,7\}$ has two sources. The transported $Q_3$ order has score two: $\{0,2,4,6\}$ and $\{2,6,10,14\}$ have two sources. Both optimized rooted scores are zero because both cubes have corner orders ending at the displayed last vertex. The example therefore refutes nonincrease for this last-preimage transport rule, not for the optimized invariant.
verification: The square-source enumeration and outgoing-pair totals are reproducible directly from the two displayed orders; the preserved manuscript also identifies the original replay artifact as papers/dismantlable-ample/research/quadratic_score_transport.py/json.
